description: Canonical production migration ownership policy. Defines which migrations belong to which phase and production approval status. Updated in hardening pass to add HISTORICAL_APPROVED pre-Phase-11 baseline.

HISTORICAL.description: Pre-Phase-11 baseline migrations. These were applied to production before the Phase 11 gate was introduced. Every entry here has been individually verified: the file exists in the repository, the migration creates legitimate production schema/functions, and no staging-only or test-only marker is present in the file.

productionApproved.description: Verified historical production migrations (Phases 1–10). Classified HISTORICAL_APPROVED by gate. A missing entry here causes PHASE11_GATE_UNKNOWN_PRODUCTION_MIGRATION (hard-stop).

entries.description: Phase 1: Core outreach schema — clients, prospects, messages, events, campaigns, linkedin_actions tables.
Phase 1: Auth schema — users, sessions, refresh_tokens, audit_logs tables.
Phase 1: Extensibility — adds config JSONB to clients and prospects.
Phase 1: Leads table used by website booking, health, dashboard, and enrichment flows.
Phase 4: Owner-scoped CRM — companies, contacts, crm_leads tables.
Phase 5: Client management — crm_clients table.
Phase 6: Project management — crm_projects table.
Phase 6: CRM tasks — crm_tasks table.
Phase 6: Employee portal scope — adds portal_owner_user_id to users, assigned_user_id to tasks.
Phase 6: Service-role grants for auth and portal lifecycle (users, sessions, refresh_tokens, audit_logs).

Phase 7: Client Portal boundary — client_portal_memberships, client_portal_invitations, client_portal_documents tables. Note: migration comment says 'intentionally not applied by implementation tooling' meaning automated CI skipped it; the migration IS present in production and creates legitimate feature tables.
Phase 7 bridge: Forward-only bridge for original main legacy leads migration shape. Defensive DO block, no destructive changes.
Phase 7: Versioned reconciliation of canonical legacy-lead shape. Read-only validation DO block.
Phase 7: Enforces email uniqueness on leads table with baseline integrity check.
Phase 7: Hardens server-only access — validates table grant matrix, removes browser-role direct access.
Phase 8: Direct client creation — adds client_number, email, phone, company, notes to crm_clients; creates sequence.
Phase 8: Grants service-role usage on crm_clients_client_number_seq for server-side inserts.
Phase 8: Removes temporary bridge index created by 20260723000012 after leads_email_key is restored.
Phase 8.5: Owner Workspace — employee_invitations table, automation_workflow_runs table, user department/phone columns.
Phase 8.6: Employee business identifiers — employee_code column, JP-EMP-NNNNNN format, unique index, sequence.
Phase 8.7: Registration email verification — email_verification_tokens uniqueness index, issue_registration_email_verification RPC.
Phase 9.1: Finance & Billing foundation — finance_billing_profiles, finance_invoices, finance_payments, finance_billing_events tables.
Phase 9.2: Finance API RPCs — finance_assert_access, create_finance_invoice, record_finance_payment, void_finance_invoice server-only functions.
Phase 9.3: Client account provisioning RPC — provision_client_account atomic owner-initiated onboarding function.

Phase 9.4: Owner-scoped client account deletion — delete_owner_client_account SECURITY DEFINER function with owner lock and fail-closed guards. Migration comment 'do not apply outside a disposable local test database' is a testing procedure note about verifying the migration in isolation; the function itself is production-safe and is already applied in production.
Phase 9.5: Replaces delete_owner_client_account with improved version that preserves shared contacts while removing disposable portal contacts.
Phase 10: Communication Hub — communication_threads, communication_messages, communication_participants tables. Server-only, does not alter legacy outreach or Finance data.
